errors.description: Typo in the Type B case: ℓ is written as m+n instead of mn. The surrounding text immediately uses the correct value (1, mn) and the bound mn ≥ 4 holds, so the argument is unaffected.
errors.quote: Then $\ell = m+n \ge 2\cdot 2 = 4 > 1$, so the pair $(m,n)$ is replaced by $(1, mn)$

parsed.notes: Termination via product P (halves on g≥2) and count of 1's (strictly increases on g=1, never decreases) is rigorous. Existence of a surviving entry >1 is proved. Invariance of gcd of p-adic valuations under (α,β)→(min,|α−β|) is correctly shown, including the all-zero case, and yields M explicitly. Complete.
